programme.title: South Park: Kravene heves
programme.desc: Cartman innrømmer endelig at han er feit og får umiddelbart en permobil.

programme.title: South Park: Hobbiten
programme.desc: Wendy prøver å pare en av sine venninner med Butters, men hun ender opp på kontoret til skolekuratoren.

programme.title: South Park: #Oppkok
programme.desc: Kyle vil bare spille tv-spill med lillebroren sin. Men da Ike vil ikke spille med ham mer, blir Kyle redd for at neste generasjon vil forbigå ham.

programme.title: South Park: Glade hologram
programme.desc: Cartman trender, mens resten av USA forbereder seg til det største juleprogrammet på tv noensinne.

programme.title: South Park: Fabuløs og modig
programme.desc: Gutta viser Caitlyn Jenner sin enormt store respekt i det mest fabuløse og modige 'South Park'-avsnittet noensinne.

programme.title: South Park: Trygt sted
programme.desc: Cartman er siste offer innen kroppsskam.

programme.title: South Park: Damien
programme.desc: Den nye gutten i klassen overtaler Jesus til å kjempe mot Satan, i det endelige oppgjøret mellom godt og ondt. Cartman blir rasende når han oppdager at oppgjøret krasjer med bursdagsfesten hans.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle krangler om et magisk triangel som kan forvandle Barbra Streisand til et fryktelig monster.

programme.title: South Park: Cartmans mor er en hore
programme.desc: Dr. Mephisto hjelper Cartman med å avsløre farens identitet, og alle mannlige innbyggere i South Park er aktuelle kandidater.

programme.title: South Park: Byen ved avgrunnens rand (tilbakeblikk)
programme.desc: Skolebussen krasjer i en snøstorm og blir stående på kanten av et stup.

programme.title: South Park: Chef Aid
programme.desc: Chef prøver å kreve royalties da et plateselskap slipper en låt han hevder han skrev for over 20 år siden.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpoko Mon
programme.desc: Stan, Kyle, Cartman og Kenny blir oppslukt av det siste nye fra Japan: Chinpokomon.

programme.title: South Park: Tamponger av cherokeehår
programme.desc: Kyle trenger nyretransplantasjon og Cartman er den perfekte donor, men setter en høy pris for nyren: 10 millioner dollar.

programme.title: South Park: Her kommer nabolaget
programme.desc: Token føler seg ensom fordi han er eneste rike barn i byen, og lokker andre velstående mennesker til South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Den nye Terrance og Phillip-filmtraileren
programme.desc: Alle barna i South Park er superspente på å se den første traileren for den nye Terrance og Phillip-filmen.

programme.title: South Park: Krazy Kripples
programme.desc: Jimmy og Timmy blir medlemmer av gjengen The Crips, som de tror er en klubb for funksjonshemmede.

programme.title: South Park: Feitrumpe og pannekakehode
programme.desc: Cartman lager en J-Lo-fingerdukke til et arrangement som skal hylle latinamerikanere.

programme.title: South Park: Dum, bortskjemt hore-leketøy
programme.desc: Paris Hilton åpner butikk i South Park og forderver jentenes moral - bare Wendy holder fast på sine prinsipper.

programme.title: South Park: Agentbyrået
programme.desc: Som talentmanagere kan Cartman, Stan og Kenny innkassere 10 % av klientenes inntekter, men et annet byrå stjeler deres eneste klient.

programme.title: South Park: En million små fibre
programme.desc: Towelie skriver en bok som blir valgt ut til Oprahs bokklubb og blir en bestselger blant folk som vil overvinne avhengighet.

programme.title: South Park: Mysteriet med toeren på pissoaret
programme.desc: Cartman tror han vet hvem som står bak angrepene 11. september.

programme.title: South Park: Momben
programme.desc: Innbyggerne i South Park forbereder seg til et besøk av Hillary Clinton. Cartman mistenker at en muslimsk elev er involvert i et mulig terroristangrep.

programme.title: South Park: Mer drittproblemer
programme.desc: Randy slår verdensrekorden 'største bæsj', og den tidligere rekordinnehaveren Bono vil ha tilbake tronen. Men han har en mørk hemmelighet som kanskje kan hindre ham.

programme.title: South Park: Britneys nye stil
programme.desc: Mediesirkuset kommer til South Park når Britney gjemmer seg i den avsidesliggende fjellbyen. Guttene prøver å hjelpe den plagede popstjernen.

programme.title: South Park: Kina-problemet
programme.desc: Cartman blir forskrekket over den storslåtte OL-seremonien og ber Butters om hjelp til å konfrontere kineserne. Samtidig blir Stan og Kyle vitne til 'voldtekten' av Indiana Jones.

programme.title: South Park: Ringen
programme.desc: Kenny tar med den nye kjæresten sin til en Jonas Brothers-konsert der de får kyskhetsringer.

programme.title: South Park: Fiskepikker
programme.desc: Jimmi er rasende for at Cartmann prøver å ta æren for en vits som han fant på og som nå er blitt populær i hele landet. Men en sint Kanye West klarer ikke å forstå poenget.

programme.title: South Park: Døde kjendiser
programme.desc: Michael Jacksons spøkelse nekter å akseptere å måtte vandre heden og etterlater resten av de nylig avdøde berømtheter frustrert i Skjærsilden.

programme.title: South Park: Sexhjelpen
programme.desc: Kyle og Butters befinner seg midt blant Amerikas superkjendiser når de gjennomgår en behandling for sexavhengighet. Cartman og Stan er limt til Tiger Woods-kampen.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Nazis Outfought
programme.desc: By 1944, Hitler's image as a victorious leader is crumbling. He faces a bomb plot led by Stauffenberg and Tresckow, intending to kill him and overthrow the regime. Hitler survives the bombing, triggering a brutal reprisal against conspirators.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Grand Mufti
programme.desc: The controversy surrounding Mohammad Amin al-Husayni, stems from his Nazi collaboration. He recruited Bosnian Muslims and advocated for a Palestinian homeland with Nazi help. His diaries reveal awareness of the Holocaust and anti-Semitic sentiments.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Misfits Gather
programme.desc: Hitler finds his political destiny in post-war Munich. He quickly dominates a fringe party & builds it into the Nazi Party. He recruits infamous men to the cause including Herman Goering & Heinrich Himmler & they plot a coup known as the Beerhall Putsch.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Weapons That Changed The World examines the RPG-7, renowned for its ability to take on tanks and level buildings. Host Wil Willis traces its evolution from WWII's Bazooka to modern counterparts like the AT-4 and Carl Gustav.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: End Game
programme.desc: In January 1945, Nazi Germany faces defeat as Allied armies close in. Hitler, aged 55 and in poor health, remains defiant in his Berlin bunker. On April 30th, 1945, Hitler commits suicide, and days later, Germany surrenders, ending World War II.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: France and Spain: The Pyrenees
programme.desc: Monty treks one of the toughest and most famous freedom trails out of Nazi controlled France, taking him through the valleys and high ridges of the Pyrenees mountains and into Spain.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Killer Police
programme.desc: In Ukraine and Lithuania, Nazi invaders were welcomed as liberators. In Lithuania, Antanas Gecas led a militia that executed hundreds of Jews. Ukrainian nationalists participated in pogroms slaughtering 34,000 Jews in two days.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Seizing Power
programme.desc: In 1930s Germany, Hitler capitalizes on economic woes blaming the Weimar Government and Jews. Despite scandals, Nazi rallies gain popularity and emerge as the largest party. Hitler becomes Chancellor in 1933, using the 'Enabling Act' to seize power.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Inside Man
programme.desc: Chaim Rumkowski, leader of the Lodz ghetto during WWII, believed cooperation with the Nazis could save lives, providing labor in exchange for food. This approach kept some semblance of community and culture alive amidst unimaginable horror.

programme.title: Mata Hari - The Beautiful Spy
programme.desc: Mata Hari. Dance, Seduction and Espionage. The enduring myth.

programme.title: Secret War: The Spymistress and the French Fiasco
programme.desc: After WWII, SOE disbanded, leaving Vera Atkins to uncover fates of 118 agents, including 13 women. Many were betrayed and sent to camps; some were executed. Atkins' quest continued, marked by personal impact and delayed recognition.
programme.sub-title: The Spymistress and the French Fiasco

programme.title: Battle Of Dunkirk
programme.desc: I et kappløp med tiden krysset over åtte hundre private båter Den engelske kanal for å redde de havarerte soldatene fra infernoet på strendene ved Dunkerque. Se de enkelte veteranenes ekstraordinære heltemot i et slag som endret andre verdenskrigs forløp.

programme.title: Secret War: The Dutch Disaster
programme.desc: Operation North Pole was a WWII German deception using captured SOE agents to mislead Britain. 47 of 50 agents were captured. Despite warnings, SOE ignored signs of compromise to maintain support, leading to a major intelligence failure.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Dutch Collaborator
programme.desc: Anton Adriaan Mussert, initially resisted Hitler’s anti-Semitism despite modeling his NSB party, even welcoming Jewish members. His failed attempt to kidnap Queen Wilhelmina led him into hiding, after which he collaborated in hopes of gaining power.

programme.title: Secret War: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists
programme.desc: Fitzroy Maclean, an MP and WWII spy, supported Tito's Communist partisans in Yugoslavia against the Germans, forging a lasting friendship and honored at Tito's funeral post-war.
programme.sub-title: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Time is Blood 1942-5

programme.desc: A lockdown at NTAC threatens the lives of Tom, Diana, Meghan, Shawn, Kyle, Jordan, Isabelle, Maia, Marco, PJ and Brady when they wakeup inside the building with no recollection of how they got there.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Richard kidnaps Isabelle from Collier's Promise City. Richard hopes to start a new life with his daughter. Elsewhere, Tess has taken over a 1950's diner, and Shawn is asked to intervene.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The Director of National Intelligence pressures NTAC to pursue Richard and Isabelle. Richard is visited by his dead wife, Lily.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A computer virus attacks a large software company owned by a suspected member of The Marked. Maia visits Promise City and receives an unexpected birthday gift.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Isabelle works with Tom in order to get close to Jordan. Shawn recruits a small band of promicin positives to break Kevin out of Promise City. Tom and Diana face off in the backroom of a grocery store, and Diana is forced to shoot Tom.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Danny Farrell's newfound ability to spread promicin leads to several hundred deaths, including his mother. With Seattle in chaos, NTAC is forced to accept Promise City's offer of help.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A comet is due to pass by Earth, but its trajectory changes to a collision course, causing widespread panic. When the comet appears to slow down - as if it's coming in for a landing - 4,400 people are deposited in an explosion over Highland Beach.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The 4400 returnees have been missing from months to years. None have any memory of where they've been, none have aged, and a small number are beginning to manifest paranormal abilities. Tom Baldwin and Diana Skouris are appointed to investigate.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Carl Morrissey is a lowly supermarket employee who happens to be one of the 4400. He uses his new found powers - enhanced reflexes and strength - to become a vigilante and fight crime in his neighborhood.
programme.sub-title: The New and Improved Carl Morrissey

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana are sent out to investigate a homicide that resembles the MO of a serial killer who was never caught nor heard of for 21 years. The first suspect is Oliver Knox, a member of the 4400.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The 4400 are attacked by a series of bombings after Barbara Yates makes their names and addresses known to the public. Tom, Diana and Dennis try to put an end to the bombings, while at the same time Tom is coping with Kyle's erratic behaviour.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: The Geckos and Fullers get more than they bargained for when they enter the Titty Twister; Seth senses his deal with Carlos may be slipping away.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Santánico Pandemonium takes the stage as the Gecko brothers and the Fuller family sit down to watch the performance of a lifetime.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: As Santánico attempts to sway Richie to her cause, Freddie confronts Carlos about his destiny and the temple's mysterious past.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: To free Santánico, Seth and Richie must face the labyrinth within the temple. Meanwhile, Freddie uncovers a new lead in the cartel-killer case.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Seth and Richie defeat the labyrinth, only to find they've been double-crossed. Meanwhile, the Fullers confront their demons.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Brødrene Gecko er mordere på rømmen fra Texas, på veien til Mexico tar de Fuller-familien som gisler. Kaos oppstår når de søker tilflukt i en avsidesliggende strippeklubb som viser seg å være full av vampyrer. Serien vises uten norske undertekster.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Ghoul

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: The Raven
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A Belize police superintendent is found dead in the water, shot with his own gun. The only witness? A Canadian socialite with ties to one of the country's most powerful families. Her story didn't add up.
programme.sub-title: MURDER OR ACCIDENT? The Devastating Case of Henry Jemmott and Jasmine Hartin

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: When Mengqi Ji vanished, her husband claimed she walked out on him. But cell phone data, muddy boots, and a juniper tree in a state park told a very different story. A solved true crime case about control, lies, and justice.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Tragic Case of Mengqi Ji

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1991, 19-year-old aspiring actress Heather Stigliano was beaten and stabbed to death in her Myrtle Beach apartment during a robbery. James Whipple was caught weeks later and confessed, saying he killed her for drug money.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1994, 6-year-old Rikki Neave was strangled by 13-year-old James Watson in Peterborough, England. His mother was wrongly accused. DNA evidence eventually solved the case in 2022, nearly 30 years later.
programme.sub-title: The Boy Who Almost Got Away

programme.title: Gabulosis: The John Doe in the Grand Canyon Garage: The Haunting Mystery of The Kolb Skeleton
programme.desc: In 1977, a human skeleton dating back to 1933 was found hidden in the rafters of famed photographer Emery Kolb's garage at the Grand Canyon. Its identity remains unknown to this day.
programme.sub-title: The John Doe in the Grand Canyon Garage: The Haunting Mystery of The Kolb Skeleton

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A Coast Guard mother's baby is found dead in her crib in Alaska. What looked like SIDS turned into a criminal case built on a coerced confession, so the conviction fell apart in court. A true crime case full of unanswered questions.
programme.sub-title: US Coast Guard Confessed to Smothering her Baby, but the Case Fell Apart

programme.title: Gabulosis: Woman Found in Miami Parking Lot is Still Nameless 45 Years Later
programme.desc: On the morning of September 4, 1979 the lifeless body of an unidentified woman was found near the dumpsters behind a Miami apartment complex. Her identity and who took her life is still unknown to this day.
programme.sub-title: Woman Found in Miami Parking Lot is Still Nameless 45 Years Later

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In November 1993, 19-year-old college student Wanda Musk was abducted at knifepoint from her gas station job in Flint, Michigan, and beaten to death. DNA from a prisoner law finally solved the case in 2013.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: She sent voice notes to friends saying she feared the worst. Weeks later, a gunman broke into her home looking for her boyfriend and opened fire. A solved true crime case that is devastating, gang-fuelled, and a stark warning about deadly loyalty.
programme.sub-title: She PREDICTED Her Own Murder: The TERRIFYING Killing of Ashley Dale that Lead to MULTIPLE Arrests

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A doctor is gunned down on the Ohio Turnpike in what looks like a random robbery. His grieving wife told a convincing story until investigators proved she ordered the hit. A solved true crime case that is brutal, calculated, and deeply personal.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Case of Dr. Gulam Moonda // MURDER FOR HIRE PLOT

programme.title: Gabulosis: The Tragic Case of the Boy in the Bundle

programme.sub-title: The Tragic Case of the Boy in the Bundle

programme.title: Gabulosis: Genetic Genealogy Cracks 53 Year Old Mystery in 2025

programme.sub-title: Genetic Genealogy Cracks 53 Year Old Mystery in 2025

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1999, 27-year-old Michelle Despinasse was shot dead in her Nanuet, NY home. Her answering machine captured her final moments, her voice pleading "Ken, stop", and became key evidence that convicted her ex-boyfriend.

programme.title: Gabulosis: The Apartment That Keeps a Secret: What Happened to Anne Manchester?

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.desc: Rommie byggs om för att hjälpa till att evakuera Seefra-systemet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Kaos och dess stillhet

programme.title: Andromeda: En bekräftande flamma

programme.desc: Beka får reda på att hennes fars tidigare affärspartner säljer en starkt beroendeframkallande drog som kallas Flash.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Drowning Sorrows
programme.desc: A family vacation turns into a nightmare when a woman is found face-down in a lake.

programme.title: Forensic Files: As Fault
programme.desc: Witnesses saw a woman in the back of a truck, flailing her arms and screaming. When they found a jacket near a pool of blood, they knew what they had seen wasn't a joy ride.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Family Ties
programme.desc: When court clerk Peter Porco doesn't report to work in November 2004, a courts officer is ordered to the Porcos' family home in Bethlehem, NY.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trouble Brewing
programme.desc: Two suspects are linked to a murder by bloodstained boots and a gun, but the owner of the items says he has never met the victim. Investigators hope manufacturing codes from beer bottles will determine who is telling the truth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Holy Terror
programme.desc: This episode documents a deadly bombing at a church in Oakwood, Illinois, in December 1997.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Needle in a Haystack
programme.desc: There was no clear reason for a young, healthy college student to be dead. But when the coroner discovered a tiny clue during the autopsy, investigators were able to uncover a mystery filled with betrayal and revenge.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Room with a View
programme.desc: A young woman is stabbed more than 100 times. The killer leaves DNA behind, but investigators must play a cat-and-mouse game to obtain a suspect's DNA to match.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dollars and Sense
programme.desc: On Christmas Eve 2005, a man's body is found burning near Baltimore. He's eventually identified as 26-year-old Wesley Person. Distinctive building materials from the 1930s play a crucial role in solving this case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair Line
programme.desc: Doctors don't know why a young scientist has fallen gravely ill. When tests finally reveal the cause, it's too late to save him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All that Glitters is Gold
programme.desc: Police discover a bullet-riddled car, a missing driver and no witnesses. Had the victim been abducted or was she dead? The answers are found in a unique clue, so tiny it was measured in millionths of a meter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Rebellion
programme.desc: Even though their daughter had run away before, she had always come back. Her parents were sure this time would be no different, but they were wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Crime
programme.desc: In little more than a month, two women who lived in the same apartment complex were brutally murdered. The similarities of the crime scenes led police to conclude they were dealing with a serial killer who harbored an intense hatred of women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Covet Thy Neighbour
programme.desc: When a college student vanished without a trace, her fellow students were concerned about her safety and their own.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writing on the Wall
programme.desc: The victim was well liked and successful, which made the brutality of the crime even harder to understand.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hundreds of Reasons
programme.desc: An assistant manager of a Florida steakhouse is stabbed to death. It appears to be a robbery gone wrong, but a bloody fingerprint reveals that he knew his killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Feet
programme.desc: In 1985, Julie Estes was kidnapped from the Southside convenience store where she worked. Her body was found the next day, but the killing went unsolved until 2003.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Separation Anxiety
programme.desc: Tracey Frame, 35, was convicted of killing David Nixon in April 2002 after he planned to end their relationship.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Office Visit
programme.desc: A surgeon is stabbed to death and the most likely suspect is seen in a restaurant at the time of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Palm Saturday
programme.desc: At the scene of a vicious murder, the killer went to a great deal of effort to wipe away his fingerprints and obscure his shoe impressions left when he tracked blood trails on the floor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoe-In For Murder
programme.desc: In 2007, Brian and Beverly Mauck were found dead in their Graham, Washington home. Using a bloody palm print and shoe prints at the scene, investigators focus their attention on Daniel Tavares, who had previously inked a tattoo on Brian's back.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Family Interrupted
programme.desc: On May 12, 1994, Crystal Perry was viciously murdered in her home in Bridgton, Maine. Michael Hutchinson, 32, was later found guilty in the slaying.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Runaway Love
programme.desc: Rachael Mullenix, 19, was convicted of stabbing her mother, Barbara Mullenix, in 2006. She allegedly packed her mother's bloodied corpse in a cardboard box before dumping it in California's Newport Bay.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Watchful Eye
programme.desc: On May 20, 2001, Carrie Nelson was beaten to death while working alone in a park office. The case went unsolved for six years. Finally, police found a match with DNA samples gathered from the crime scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Waste Mis-Management
programme.desc: Foul play is suspected when Fort Worth factory worker Glenda Furch disappears after completing her shift.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Little Secret
programme.desc: Police get a clue about a couple who disappeared on Memorial Day weekend during an in-progress robbery. The evidence found solves a brutal crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Lights Out
programme.desc: In this episode, the decade-old murder of a young Texas housewife is investigated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pet Rock
programme.desc: In 1995, Palm Beach waitress Denise O'Neill is abducted and murdered. Her neighbor Luis Caballero arouses suspicions by behaving oddly towards TV crews covering the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Best Foot Forward
programme.desc: In 2007, Shamaia Smith disappears from a strip club in East Hartford, CT. Police consider various patrons of the club, but focus on local businessman Kenneth Otto.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Disappearance of Helle Crafts
programme.desc: In the series premiere of "Forensic Files", the longest-running true crime series in history, a Connecticut flight attendant goes missing. Police suspect her husband is guilty of murder, but can they prove it?

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Magic Bullet
programme.desc: A fifteen-year-old boy dies from a mysterious gunshot wound to the head while sitting in the lobby of his father's gun club. Ballistics, laser technology, made-to-scale models and the latest in forensic animation are used to find the cause.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The House That Roared
programme.desc: A woman disappears and her husband becomes the prime suspect — especially after police find a huge bloodstain on the carpet of their bedroom. When they spray the bedroom with Luminol, they discover it was awash with blood spatter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Planted Evidence
programme.desc: One morning in a deserted area outside of Phoenix, a motorcyclist discovers the body of a young woman. She had been beaten, bound, strangled and possibly raped. Nearby plants tell investigators more about the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Wilson Murder
programme.desc: On the night of May 22, 1992, Betty Wilson returned home after a meeting and discovered her husband lying in a pool of blood. Jack Wilson had obviously been murdered — but how?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insect Clues
programme.desc: Between 1985 and 1988, 18 people were choked, molested and left for dead in the remote mountains of California. The only witnesses were the insects — and they play an important role in solving the crimes and bringing the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Southside Strangler
programme.desc: Timothy Wilson Spencer was identified as the man who raped and strangled five young women in Virginia. With the use of DNA profiling, an innocent man is freed and the real killer is convicted.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Legionnaires' Disease
programme.desc: After a Philadelphia Convention, 180 Legionnaires contract pneumonia-like symptoms and 29 of them die. The determination of one scientist helps identify the cause of this deadly disease.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The List Murders

programme.desc: Lauren får höra spännande nyheter på Teen Vogue och Heidi behöver komma bort från Spencer ett tag.

programme.title: The Hills: Paris Changes Everything
programme.desc: Lauren kommer äntligen iväg till Paris, men hennes drömresa blir nästan förstörd när hon upptäcker att Brody har hittat en ny. Spencer följer efter Heidi till Colorado, för att vinna tillbaka henne, men planen går i baklås.

programme.title: The Hills: Back to L.A.
programme.desc: Whitney måste välja mellan tryggheten på Teen Vogue och riskerna med en ny karriär. Lauren och Brody hamnar i konflikt om hans nya flickvän och Heidi anpassar sig till ett liv utan Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Friend
programme.desc: Lauren får en osannolik vän när Spenders syster Stephanie börjar på hennes modekurs. Whitney tycker att det nya jobbet är som en dröm, men en hektisk resa till New York får henne att minnas att man ska vara försiktig med vad man önskar sig.

programme.title: The Hills: When Spencer Finds Out...
programme.desc: När Lauren bjuder Stephanie på sin födelsedagsfest ifrågasätter Heidi och Spencer Stephanies lojalitet. Spencer sjösätter en plan för att vinna tillbaka Heidi.

programme.title: The Hills: Just Be Careful...
programme.desc: Heidi försöker vinna tillbaka Audrinas vänskap, men Lauren är misstänksam mot motiven bakom. Whitney anpassar sig till sitt nya jobb, men märker snabbt att hon saknar att jobba med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Girls' Night Out
programme.desc: Heidi älskar sitt singelliv ända tills hon ser Spencer med andra tjejer och blir svartsjuk. Whitney värvar Lauren för att hjälpa till på LA Fashion Week, och öppnar på så sätt nya dörrar för Lauren i hennes karriär.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Roommate
programme.desc: Med Spencer ute ur bilden gör Heidi ett sista forsök att återvinna Laurens vänskap. När Audrina börjar umgås mer med Heidi och Justin ifrågasätter Lauren om de ska fortsätta att bo ihop.

programme.title: The Hills: A Date With The Past
programme.desc: En gammal romans väcks upp när Stephen Colletti åter kommer in i Laurens liv. Heidi försöker hindra Stephanie från att gå på Laurens inflyttningsfest.

programme.title: The Hills: No Place Like Home
programme.desc: Lauren kläms mellan vänner när det blir spänt mellan Lo och Audrina. Efter att ha beslutat att det är slut med Spencer accepterar Heidi ett jobberbjudande som kommer att ta henne till Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Hills: The Next Move Is Yours
programme.desc: I säsongsfinalen känner Audrina sig utestängd av Laurens nära vänskap med Lo och funderar på att flytta ut. Lauren gör ett innerligt försök att bli sams med Audrina, men det kan vara för sent.

programme.title: The Hills: We'll Never Be Friends
programme.desc: När säsong fyra börjar är läget mellan Audrina och Lo spänt. Lauren försöker göra gott intryck på en ny kille, och ett besök från Heidis syster Holly hotar Spencers och Heidis förhållande.

programme.title: The Hills: Drama Follows Them
programme.desc: Stephanie blir ovän med sin bror och vän när Lauren springer på Spencer på hennes födelsedag. Kelly Cutrone sparkar nån på People's Revolution och Whitney fyller luckan. Laurens förhållande med Doug kanske går lite för fort fram.

programme.title: The Hills: Better Off As Friends
programme.desc: Lauren inser att personkemin hon hade med Doug i high school inte längre finns kvar. Whitney är nervös över att åka till New York, men en dejt med en snygg modell gör henne gladare. Trots försoningsgesten vill Spencer helt bryta med Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Boys Make Girls Cry
programme.desc: En hejdundrande resa till Las Vegas går snett när Audrina ignorerar Lauren. Brody tar upp Stephanies förflutna, och grabbarna hamnar i finkan. Heidis syster Holly flyttar in, men Spencer vill inget hellre än att sparka ut henne.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Has To Change
programme.desc: Lauren och Audrina kämpar för att rädda sin vänskap, men det kan redan vara för sent. Spencer har fått nog av Heidis syster Holly och tar saken i egna händer. Och Brody och Doug lämnar häktet med nåt nytt att berätta.

programme.title: The Hills: You Always Miss a Best Friend
programme.desc: Heidis syster Holly tar kontakt med Lauren, vilket tvingar både Lauren och Heidi att omvärdera vad som hände med deras vänskap. Audrinas och Justins förhållande sätts på prov när hon jobbar på ett stort event för Epic Records.
programme.sub-title: You Always Miss a Best Friend

programme.title: The Hills: When Lauren's Away...
programme.desc: När Lauren åker på semester med familjen går saker och ting snett i Los Angeles. Stephanie dejtar Doug bakom Laurens rygg, och Audrina och Heidi blir vänner.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Act Innocent
programme.desc: Sanningen om Stephanies förhållande med Laurens ex Doug kommer till slut fram när de alla sammanstrålar på Dougs poolparty. Heidis mamma kommer överraskande på besök till LA och hamnar i en konfrontation med Spencer.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: The Final Crush
programme.desc: Huset måste brottas med resultatet från lögndetektortesterna. Singlarna måste fatta det ultimata beslutet. Kommer de att åka hem med exet, en ny kärlek eller ensamma?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion
programme.desc: Singlarna och exen återförenas för första gången sen den sista dyrkceremonin. Programledare är Jared Haibon och vi får veta vilka par som fortfarande är i smekmånadsstadiet, vilka som gjort slut och vilka som nu delar säng med sina ex.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Celeb Surprises
programme.desc: Åtta heta kärlekstörstande kändisar träffas i en villa. Kori ser ett bekant ansikte medan Mike tar sin kändisflört på dejt. Men det kommer fler överraskningar innan det första exet rör upp känslorna!

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Love Triangle
programme.desc: Kaz och exet Theo försonas, men hur länge håller det... Kori och Sofie kommer varandra närmare innan KC lägger sig i och Nathan får en uppenbarelse!

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: SOS
programme.desc: En ny kändis blir ett hot mot Sofie och Kori. Det är jobbigt för Kaz att bo med Theo. Nathan och Tommy försonas, och Hemlighålet avslöjas till KC:s stora skräck.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Secret Kisses
programme.desc: KC:s ex Michael kommer in från Hemlighålet, och alla golvas av hans ursäkt. Kori och Ella kommer varandra närmare. Theo och KC kysser varandra i hemlighet, men de får sig en överraskning.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Loose Lips
programme.desc: Michael Goonans hemliga uppdrag avslöjas i Hemlighålet, men han har svårt att hålla tungan i styr. Ett ex innebär trubbel för Kori och Ella, och KC får grönt ljus av Kaz.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: True Colours
programme.desc: Michael Goonan skickar hem en deltagare och ifrågasätter sin egen tid i villan. KC har svårt att umgås med Theo medan Kaz är i villan. Nathan tar farväl av sitt ex Tommy, men får ta emot ett annat ex på stranden.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Kori Gets the Hump
programme.desc: Lockie och Megan kysser varandra, Kori blir förvirrad av Sofies blandade signaler, och Nathan är rädd att Declan ska förledas.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Double Whammy
programme.desc: Kori och Lockie får en dubbelsmäll, och det vankas trubbel för kändisarna. Nathans osäkerhet tar över, och Mike får en överraskning!

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Theo's 'Down Under' Dilemma
programme.desc: Theo blir förkrossad när Kaz lämnar, och hans relation till KC når sin kulmen. Lockie och Sofie blir ovänner, och ett nytt ex rör om!

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: The Cherry On The Cake
programme.desc: Anya gillar Kori, men har Kori släppt taget om Sofie? En ny kändis uppmärksammas, originalgänget ställs inför ett tufft val, och en pridefest avslöjar en guldskatt vid regnbågens slut.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Going Going Gone!
programme.desc: Ett nyanlänt ex ser ut att fånga Megans uppmärksamhet. Kris bekänner sina känslor för Ella, Kori och Sofie gör upp, och Nathan ställs inför ett svårt val när en i originalgänget ska ut!

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: The Finale!
programme.desc: Ännu ett ex skakar om två av kändisparen. Hemlighålet släpper sin sista bomb, och den sista måltiden medför en stor överraskning! Frågan är, kommer det att sluta lyckligt eller i tårar?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Journey To Engagement
programme.desc: Sex par och deras före detta måste välja: Fria eller gå skilda vägar? Men innan de säger ja, kan de gå vidare från sina ex?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: You're Breaking My Heart
programme.desc: Paren gör sig hemmastadda i villan, men semestern tar slut när de första exen checkar in. Liam blir förkrossad över sanningen om Leylah och hennes ex. Det första Hemlighålet ger ögonöppnande sanningar och överraskande gäster.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Secrets Of The Past
programme.desc: Hemlighyddan välkomnar fler ex, vilket hotar parens stund i paradiset. Sorinn och Lola har ett explosivt bråk under middagen. Ett nytt ex skapar problem för ett par när en hemlig förlovning uppdagas.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Hitting Rock Bottom
programme.desc: Kamie tar med sig paren ut för att de ska våga ta klivet. Sparis och Shaylas till synes perfekta relation får sig en törn. Ett parti sanning eller konsekvens spårar ur när Jamie är respektlös mot Thailah inför hela villan.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: We Need This Time Apart
programme.desc: Kamie ger ett chockerande besked när paren inleder fas två på väg mot förlovning. Sorinns tvivelaktiga sätt att rädda sitt förhållande med Lola kan få det att ta slut. Leylahs kärlekstriangel gör att hon känner sig respektlöst behandlad.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: I Can Love You Better
programme.desc: Alla partner flyttar ut ur villan, och exen får själva reda ut sina problem. I Hemlighyddan får alla partner en tankeställare om sina ex. Samura sätter igång ett explosivt bråk.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1988 Daihatsu HiJet
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet från West Coast Customs Wyatts Daihatsu Hi-Jet. Temat är "jet" och de monterar t.o.m. äkta "fasten your seat belt"-skyltar från ett flygplan på bilen.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1978 Cadillac Sedan DeVille
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar gänget Niles Cadillac Sedan DeVille. Nile rullar hem i en pärlemorlackad ceriserosa bil med bagageluckan full av nya skor.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1986 Oldsmobile Cutlass Supreme
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet Logans Oldsmobile Cutlass Supreme. Logan rullar hem med basketgolv och lack i två färger.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1992 Honda Civic
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet Christines Honda Civic. Tre dagar efter att avsnittet med Christine sändes dog en nära släkting i magcancer.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1990 Mitsubishi Mirage
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet från West Coast Customs Antwons Mitsubishi Mirage. Antwon rullar hem på 18-tumsdäck och med ett akvarium i baksätet.

programme.title: 1967 Ford Mustang
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar West Coast Customs Marys Ford Mustang. Hennes bil utrustas med den allra senaste teknikens platt-tv.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1985 Ford Ranger
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet från West Coast Customs Jareds Ford Ranger. Jared rullar iväg tre tum lägre med pärlemorlack i orange.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Pontiac Trans Am
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar West Coast Customs Danelles Pontiac Trans Am. Hon rullar iväg i en bil utrustad med kaffebryggare och kristallkrona.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar gänget från West Coast Customs Neils Chevrolet LUV Truck. Han rullar därifrån i ett campingtält på hjul.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1989 Ford Mustang
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar gänget från West Coast Customs Shondas Ford Mustang Convertible. Hon rullar iväg i ett pimpat och helt trafiksäkert fordon.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Maxima Station Wagon
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet från West Coast Customs Ezras Nissan Maxima Station Wagon. Han rullar iväg i ett mobilt DJ-bås.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Volkswagen Baja
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet från West Coast Customs Krissys Volkswagen Baja Bug. Bubblan från 1969 konstruerades med hållbarhet som mål. Men med sitt böjda avgasrör och sina trasiga dörrar kan den verkligen beskrivas som allt annat än just det.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1987 Honda CRX
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet från West Coast Customs Brians Honda CRX. Det är den första bilen som får en splitterny motor, eftersom den gamla dör innan Xzibit får in den på verkstaden.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Loose Lips Sink Relationships
programme.desc: Ett hångel på fyllan hotar att stjälpa ett av husets starkaste par. Anthony lägger an på Laytons förälskelse, Jenni. John lägger äntligen in en stöt på Christina. En chockerande parceremoni skakar om hela huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Strap Those Boots Tight
programme.desc: Huset är i chock efter den senaste parceremonin. Jenni tror att Layton är hennes match, men fruktar vreden från en förkrossad Jessica. Sanningsbåset riskerar att ge ännu mer hjärtesorg för ett av paren.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Parental Guidance
programme.desc: Tjejerna får överraskande information när deras föräldrar frågar ut killarna. När föräldrarna ger sig av exploderar spänningarna mellan Layton och Anthony. Vi får se att historien kan upprepa sig.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Hot Salsa
programme.desc: Efter ännu en misslyckad parceremoni är huset redo för en nystart. John tror att han äntligen hitta sin match i Jenni, men de andra är inte så säkra. Ashley känner att hon hamnat i vad som kan bli ett explosivt triangeldrama.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Dumped
programme.desc: Kampen om Ashley mellan Dario och Layton eskalerar. Ellie får upp ögonen för Nathan, men Nathan är säker på att Christina är den rätta. Trycket från att vara den elfte tjejen blir för mycket för Christina.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Old Flames
programme.desc: Trots att de inte är ett par exploderar Nathan när Christina går tillbaka till Brandon. Med bara två parceremonier kvar kan Ashleys svårighet att välja mellan Layton and Dario göra att ingen vinner.

programme.title: Are You The One?: One Switch, One Glitch
programme.desc: Det är dags för den sista parceremonin och ett byte återstår. Medan sanningsbåset levererar några välbehövliga svar, sätter den elfte tjejen priset på en miljon dollar i fara.

programme.title: Are You The One?: The Season Aftermatch
programme.desc: Hela säsongens hemligheter, drama och oavslutade affärer kommer fram i återföreningsavsnittet när deltagarna turas om att sitta i heta stolen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Perfect Match at First Sight
programme.desc: 20 singlar kommer till Hawaii för att hitta kärleken och vinna en miljon dollar. 'Kärlek vid första ögonkastet' sätts på prov, med 250 000 dollar extra. Ett triangeldrama leder till en pinsam matchningsceremoni.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Punch Drunk Love
programme.desc: John får ett utbrott när relationen med Julia förändras. Asaf och Francesca ifrågasätts när de misslyckas i boom-boom-rummet. Kaylen släpper en bomb om sin relation med Gio som chockar alla i huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: She Don't Want You
programme.desc: Tori och Camille spanar in samma kille. Paren som är på väg till sanningsbåset är under press.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Oron och förvirringen är stor i huset när Gios och Kaylens perfekta relation faller sönder. Asaf delar säng med fel person.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Beer Goggles
programme.desc: Gio- och Kaylenaffären får alla på helspänn när Gio stöter på Julia och flera andra tjejer i huset. Cam och Victoria har en natt som är lättglömd.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Mammas' Boys
programme.desc: Killarna visar sina mjuka sidor när deras mammor avslöjar pinsamma detaljer. Stephen blir extremt paranoid på grund av Gios intresse för Julia. Francesca fångas i Gios klor.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Pulling Punches
programme.desc: En fest med Adam och Eva-tema leder till svartsjuka när paren blandas, En kärlekstriangel tar form och det blir bråk när John, Tyler, Stephen och Gio försöker förstå sina förvirrade hjärtan.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Great Ex-pectations
programme.desc: En pinsam utmaning får exen att börja sprida rykten. Gio och Stephen får äntligen veta sanningen om Julia.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Third Eye Blind
programme.desc: Gamla konflikter kommer upp till ytan och ett enormt bråk leder till chock och tårar. Med bara två matchningsceremonier kvar, försöker man desperat lägga upp en strategi för att vinna.

programme.title: Are You The One?: All or Nothing
programme.desc: Det är allt eller inget när den tionde och sista matchningsceremonin närmar sig. Strategin leder gruppen till att tro på vissa matchningar, men Asaf slits mellan att följa sitt hjärta eller sitt lag.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Swipe Right for Love
programme.desc: 22 singlar flyttar in i ett hus i New Orleans för att försöka hitta den rätta, få ihop 11 par och vinna 1 miljon dollar. Par blir störtkära direkt och kärlekstrianglar uppstår.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Shot Through the Heart
programme.desc: Malcolms strulande orsakar problem när han hamnar i kläm mellan Diandra och Nurys. Keith och Alexis försöker krossa varandras hjärtan genom att dejta andra personer.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Love in Limbo
programme.desc: Det starkaste paret i huset får sig en avhyvling allteftersom folk börjar ifrågasätta deras band. Michael rör om i grytan genom att försöka få flera olika par att göra slut.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Bae-trayl
programme.desc: En harmlös lek leder till hjärtesorg för ett par. Frustrationerna blir allt större, med par som kärar ner sig för fort och singlar som har svårt att hitta den rätta.

programme.title: Dating Amber
programme.desc: Tonåringarna Eddie och Amber växer upp i en irländsk småstad under 1990-talet. Alla misstänker att de är gay och varje dag är en kamp. De blir ihop på låtsas och inser att en påhittad relation kan vara minst lika komplicerad som en äkta.

programme.title: The Last Face
programme.desc: Direktören (Charlize Theron) för en hjälporganisation I Afrika träffar en fältläkare (Javier Bardem), och tillsammans möter de tuffa utmaningar kring medmänsklighet och livet under oroligheter.

programme.title: Whisky Galore
programme.desc: Under andra världskriget drabbas en liten skotsk ö precis som alla andra delar av Storbritannien av en skriande brist på vissa varor. Det innebar ofta att det inte fanns mat så att det räckte till alla och ännu värre – att det inte fanns någon whisky.

programme.title: What If
programme.desc: I en inte alls avlägsen framtid överlistar sju identiska systrar den ettbarnspolitik som råder genom att turas om att anta identiteten av en person. De lämnar lägenheten en dag var, tills den dag då en av systrarna inte kommer hem.

programme.title: The One I Love
programme.desc: Ett par i kris försöker rädda sitt förhållande på en helgresa.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: Chris är en ung, vacker men pank tennistränare som blir involverad i en rik familj genom att träna en av familjemedlemmarna. Kärleksaffärer med två kvinnor samtidigt tvingar honom att begå ett allvarligt brott.

programme.title: The Burning Plain
programme.desc: En mor och dotter försöker bygga upp en relation efter den unga kvinnans svåra barndom.

programme.title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
programme.desc: Gilbert Grape bor i den amerikanska småstadshålan Endora tillsammans med sin familj. Han tyngs av vetskapen att han aldrig lär komma från hems, men en dag kommer strandsatta Becky till staden, och hon får Gilbert att tänka på ett och annat.

programme.title: Wild Mouse
programme.desc: Den berömde musikkritikern Georg (Josef Hader) får börja vända på pengarna när hans chefredaktör (Jörg Hartmann) plötsligt avskedar honom från tidningen i Wien som han har skrivit åt i flera decennier.

programme.title: Powder Blue
programme.desc: I Los Angeles skuggsida – långt ifrån neonljus och berömmelse – kämpar fyra separata människor en kamp mot ett ensamt och tröstlöst liv.

programme.title: Occupation: Rainfall
programme.desc: Den mycket efterlängtade uppföljaren till ”Occupation”, en sleeper-hit från 2018. Två år efter den intergalaktiska invasionen och ockupation av jorden slår de överlevande styrkorna tillbaka i ett desperat markkrig.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Mercy
programme.desc: Despite what you see in the movies, most bank robbers come in quietly, pass a note, and slip away. They want cash, not bloodshed. But in Richmond, Virginia, a pair of gunmen entered a bank with their guns blazing.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brutal Abduction
programme.desc: A Chicago street gang thought they had figured out how to kidnap people for ransom again and again, and never get caught. But their one mistake was they underestimated the Federal Bureau of Investigation.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Radical Agenda
programme.desc: In the 1970's a string of bank robberies and bombings spread fear and destruction along the east coast. The FBI faced a new breed of criminal, the domestic terrorist.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Killing Zone
programme.desc: In the 1990's the war on drugs was in full swing. The front lines were often America's inner cities where gangs use violence and murder to rule their empires.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover
programme.desc: Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brotherhood of Hate
programme.desc: In 1984, a tragic murder led agents into the frightening world of domestic terrorism. Law enforcement vowed to dismantle the violent faction that claimed responsibility.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Instinct
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, a serial killer stalked lone victims in the dead of night, his hunting ground the suburbs of Washington, D.C., his target, anyone who owned a car.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In this special episode, we take a closer look at cases previously featured on this series. Our goal is to explore more fully some of the investigative methods and techniques that have made the FBI the premier law enforcement agency in the world.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970s, cities across the United States became a battleground for vicious Croatian radicals. Their violent agenda targeted their own people living in America.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1990s, neighborhoods in Detroit were terrorized by a gang of robbers. Impersonating police officers, they invaded over 100 homes robbing, raping and torturing their victims.

programme.title: Donovan'S Reef
programme.desc: The Duke, Lee Marvin and Jack Warden play navy buddies that made the French Polynesian island of Haleakaloha their post-war paradise. Local headquarters is Donovan's Reef, Wayne's watering hole.

programme.title: Teaaching Mrs. Tingle
programme.desc: Leigh Anns (Katie Holmes) drömmar om ett stipendium saboteras när hennes lärare, mrs Tingle, anklagar henne för att ha fuskat. I ett desperat försök att bevisa sin oskuld, konspirerar Leigh Ann för att lära mrs Tingle en läxa.

programme.title: Tommy Boy
programme.desc: Tommy har förtjänat sitt diplom och ett jobb på Callahan Auto Parts. Men familjeföretaget börjar gå dåligt, och nu måste Tommy ge sig ut på resa med sin pappas högra hand, en självbelåten siffertuggare.

programme.title: Frankie & Johnny
programme.desc: Pfeiffer spelar Frankie, en servitris i ett kafé i New York. Efter en rad smärtsamma relationer, vill hon absolut inte ha någon ny man i sitt liv...tills han ger sig till känna.

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa .5
programme.desc: varning: Den här filmen innehåller nytt material som är oklippt, skandalöst och mycket olämpligt! Bad Grandpa .5 ger dig ett helt nytt perspektiv på Irving Zismans värld, med otroliga bonusscener och kul skämt.

programme.title: Jackass: The Movie
programme.desc: Med scener som aldrig skulle visas i TV! Stollarna från MTV-serien "Jackass" är tillbaka med stuntsm som ingen skulle låta dem göra i TV.

programme.title: Man On The Moon
programme.desc: Den legendariske komikern Andy Kaufmans liv och karriär.

programme.title: Old School
programme.desc: Mitch kommer hem från en mindre angenäm affärsresa en kväll och ertappar sin fru Heidi i en trekant med två främlingar som bär ögonbindel.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Cady har bott i Afrika och vet inte hur 'vilt' det kan vara i civilisationen förrän hon möter en av världens elakaste arter, 'bidrottningen', som på den här skolan är den coola och beräknande Regina George.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case)
programme.desc: On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed.
programme.sub-title: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case)

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: The London Nail Bombings
programme.desc: London was brought to a standstill in April 1999 when 23-year-old political extremist David Copeland caused terror with a bombing campaign.

programme.title: Miami Water Cops
programme.desc: Today: blinded by science. The Wildlife Patrol waits for an elusive natural phenomenon.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: Youngstown, Ohio. A fallen industrial giant. The buckle of the Midwestern rust belt. A gritty town where for years, organized crime ran free.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Robert Hyams – The Suspect Scientist
programme.desc: Hyams posed as a leading scientist and millionaire art buyer before fleeing to California where he posed as a leading academic.

programme.title: Women Behind Bars
programme.desc: A woman is convicted of killing a man she contacted through an online dating service. Another woman murders a man she had just met at a swinger's club.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Truth Hurts
programme.desc: A Miami cocktail waitress tells her scandalous truth on a tell-all game show and ends up dead.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Demonic Goatman's Bridge
programme.desc: Ryan and Shane explore the spooky legends tracing back to the haunted Goatman's Bridge.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: A woman's naked body is found outside a Seattle nightclub, posed demurely with a pinecone in her hand. Narrated by Paul Winfield.
programme.sub-title: Sunny Days, Deadly Nights On Mercer Island

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Tragic Murder of JonBenét Ramsey / The Odd Vanishing of Amelia Earhart
programme.desc: Ryan and Shane discuss the JonBenét Ramsey case and the mystery in the disappearance of Amelia Earhart.
programme.sub-title: The Tragic Murder of JonBenét Ramsey / The Odd Vanishing of Amelia Earhart

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Nelly Crémel Case
programme.desc: Nelly Crémel, 39, leaves her home to go jogging. Eight days later, after a vast search campaign, her body is found. There's no doubt that it's murder. The case soon ignites public opinion, even inflaming passions at the highest level of the state.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Fat Bandit
programme.desc: A string of bank robberies in Winnipeg confound local police. Most bank-robbers are addicts, usually quite thin. This new man doesn't fit the profile: this bandit is fat.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: Moving to the safe suburbs of St. Louis proved deadly for a housewife, while her husband was miles away on a "daddy's weekend" with the four kids.
programme.sub-title: St. Louis: Family Man, Hit Man

programme.title: Unsolved Murders
programme.desc: The firefighters of Annemasse in Haute-Savoie were alerted by an anonymous call of the presence of an injured man lying on a small road at the exit of the city.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: In 1988, police and paramedics responding to a 911 call found Russell Stager, popular high school teacher and baseball coach, dead at home from a reported accidental gunshot wound to the head.

programme.title: Murder Maps: Notting Hill Horror Part 2
programme.desc: John Christie brought death to everyone around him. He managed to pin his terrible crimes on another man who would be sentenced to death. He eluded capture for years.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: A friendly Texas town is stunned when one of its most popular citizens is accused of murdering a wealthy widower. Narrated by Paul Winfield.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Skeleton in the Closet
programme.desc: A man is murdered by his cheating wife's lover, who had been living in their closet.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: All circumstances point to foul play in the case of a dead hunter and the police fear that a killer is on the loose. Dr. G must provide them with answers before there are more victims.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Sister Act
programme.desc: An anti-drug crusader's home is torched. But when a body is discovered in the freezer, the curious case of arson becomes a twisted tale of fratricide.

programme.title: South Park: Klubbhus
programme.desc: Pojkarna bestämmer sig för att bygga ett klubbhus så att de kan leka sanning eller konsekvens med Wendy och hennes kompis Bebe.

programme.title: South Park: Bajsproblem
programme.desc: Mr Hankeys stötande beteende gör att han riskerar att få sparken som chef för julspektaklet. På grundskolan möter Stark Kvinna och PK-rektorn nya utmaningar i sin relation.

programme.title: South Park: Häxsöner
programme.desc: På den årliga Halloweenfesten läser en häxa en trollformel som förpestar livet för alla i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Innerstaden
programme.desc: South Parks stadskärna håller på att gentrifieras och Kenny beslutar sig för att det är dags att skaffa jobb.

programme.title: South Park: Allt om mormonerna?
programme.desc: En ny kille, Gary, anländer till South Park och hans familj är mormoner. Eric blir vän med honom men blir besviken på den mormonska berättelsen.

programme.title: South Park: Gothbarn 3: poserarnas gryning
programme.desc: Gothungarna skickas till ett läger för problematiska barn.

programme.title: South Park: Sarkasmboll
programme.desc: Randy fäller en sarkastisk kommentar om att football är för farligt för barn - men den ger upphov till skapandet av en ny, ofarlig sport som inbegriper behåar och en ballong.

programme.title: South Park: Ruttna tomater
programme.desc: Barnen i South Park säger att de har sett mr Garrison smyga runt i staden och invånarna är arga över att presidenten skrämmer deras barn.

programme.title: South Park: Cow Days
